notes.title: Patch for Jan 31.
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes:[/b]
+Added unique icon when plants are affected by sprinkler

* Fixed weed workers not being able to identify empty drying racks
* Fixed meth workers targeting the same cooling station
* Fixed dealer icons flashing while in the dealer menu

notes.title: Worker bugfix
notes.notes:
We have reworked the entire worker code, fixing all major bugs surrounding workers

[b]Changes[/b]

- Reworked the entire worker code from scratch
- Weed workers now plant seed right after harvesting plants
- Workers no longer play an animation when harvesting dried weed, speeding up the process
- A notification now pops up telling you why a property is locked

[b]Fixes[/b]
* Workers no longer get stuck at tasks
* Restockers no longer complain about lack of shelf space when shelves aren’t full.
